storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP JustForFans Downloader makes it easy to save content from JustFor.Fans to your computer.

How it works: Go to any creator's page on JustForFans, scroll through their feed, and click "Download Visible" to save all videos, images, and text posts currently on screen. Or use the per-post download button on individual items. The extension scans the feed, detects all media types, and downloads them directly to your computer.

It handles HLS streaming, DASH encrypted video, Autograph CDN delivery, and gallery/carousel expansion automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save as MP4, images save at full resolution, and everything goes to an organized JustForFans subfolder in your Downloads.

Key features:
- Feed-aware scanning — detects videos, images, gallery posts, and text content
- Per-post download button on every feed item
- "Download Visible" button for batch downloading all content on screen
- Converts HLS streams and DASH encrypted video to standard MP4 files
- Gallery/carousel expansion to capture all images in multi-image posts
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick video downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to JustFor.Fans and navigate to a creator's page
3. Click the extension icon to see detected content (Videos, Images, Text tabs)
4. Click "Download Visible" or use per-post buttons — content saves to your Downloads/JustForFans folder

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download content from JustForFans?
faq.answer: Go to any creator's page on JustFor.Fans. Click the extension icon to see detected content organized by type (Videos, Images, Text). Click "Download Visible" to save everything, or use the download button on individual posts.

faq.question: What types of content can I download?
faq.answer: Videos (saved as MP4), images (full resolution, including gallery/carousel posts), and text posts.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available video qualities from the source. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS and DASH streams are converted automatically.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Content automatically saves to a JustForFans subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my content?
faq.answer: Scroll through the creator's feed to load content first. The extension scans visible posts on the page. If issues persist, click the "Rescan" button or refresh the page.

faq.question: Can I download gallery/carousel posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension automatically expands gallery and carousel posts to capture all images in multi-image posts.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension only accesses JustFor.Fans pages.

faq.question: What if a video uses DRM/encryption?
faq.answer: The extension includes DASH decryption support for encrypted streams commonly used on JustForFans. Most protected content can be downloaded.
